gates.name: unit
gates.command: docker compose up -d postgres minio; docker run --rm --network accountingautomation_default -v "${REPO}:/src:ro" -v arnibooks_ai_node_modules:/work/node_modules -w /work node:22 bash /src/scripts/ai/unit-inner.sh test

gates.name: pytest
gates.command: docker compose up -d postgres minio; docker run --rm --network accountingautomation_default -e S3_ENDPOINT=http://minio:9000 -v "${REPO}:/src:ro" -v arnibooks_ai_venv:/venv -v arnibooks_ai_pycache:/root/.cache -w /work python:3.12 bash /src/scripts/ai/pytest-inner.sh
